title: Grade C/D never re-leased without refurbishment
description: Secondary Re-lease always includes a full refurbishment; grade D and scrap are never re-leased.

title: Refurbishment always ends in a named lease or sales order
description: A refurbishment slot is only used against a named lease order or renewal.

title: Parts certified only at or above the fit-for-use threshold
description: Harvested parts count only when their remaining life is at least the fit-for-use threshold (50 %).

title: Holding cost rate set by Finance
description: The holding cost per day is a Finance policy rate and cannot be changed by a business rule.

title: Every decision approved by a named owner
description: No route is executed until a named owner approves it.

title: Exit and material only through a certified provider
description: Material Recovery and Responsible Exit use certified providers with a certificate on file.
